title: Tech Conference Banner (Ideogram)
description: Modern tech conference banner for event marketing, social media ads, and SaaS landing pages.

prompt.main: modern tech conference banner, gradient blue and purple background with abstract geometric shapes, large bold text "AI SUMMIT 2025" in white sans-serif, smaller text "San Francisco | Oct 15-17" below, clean modern tech aesthetic, professional event marketing --ar 16:9
prompt.negative: vintage, organic, photo, busy, hand drawn

explained.why: Design style for tech marketing layouts.

tutorial.intro: Tech conference banner = event name + date + location + gradient + geometric. Specific details sell event tickets.
steps: Background: gradient blue and purple background with abstract geometric shapes 鈥?gradient + geometry.
Title: large bold text "AI SUMMIT 2025" in white sans-serif 鈥?actual event name.
Date: smaller text "San Francisco | Oct 15-17" below 鈥?city + dates.
Aesthetic: clean modern tech aesthetic, professional event marketing 鈥?quality reference.
tutorial.tips: Tech events: name + city + dates. Without city + dates, you get a generic tech poster.

crossModel.midjourney: MJ v6.1: "tech conference banner, AI SUMMIT 2025, blue purple --ar 16:9 --v 6.1 --s 500".
crossModel.stable_diffusion: SDXL with controlnet. Use Ideogram for text.
crossModel.dall_e: DALL-E 3: "A modern tech conference banner with the text AI SUMMIT 2025, San Francisco Oct 15-17, blue and purple gradient".

faq.q: Why is my event name misspelled?
faq.a: Ideogram is the most reliable for text. Use it for all event marketing visuals.

faq.q: Best aspect ratio for event banners?
faq.a: 16:9 for Twitter/LinkedIn. 9:16 for Instagram Stories. 1:1 for square ads.

faq.q: How to make it look premium?
faq.a: Gradient + geometric + sans-serif + city + dates. Five elements = premium tech event.
